look.why: A deep Ituri rainforest green that highlights the velvety chocolate coat and crisp white zebra-striped legs.

size.measure: nose to tail tip, about 2.4 m (body 1.9–2.5 m plus 30–42 cm tufted tail per ADW)

habitat.text: Dense lowland tropical rainforests—especially the Ituri Forest—in the northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo.

diet.text: Tree leaves, buds, shoots, ferns, fruits and fungi stripped with its long dark-blue prehensile tongue.

facts.text: Despite its zebra-striped legs, the okapi is the giraffe's only living relative and shares its long blue tongue and skin-covered ossicones.
Its tongue is up to 45 cm long—long enough to wash its own eyelids and clean inside its ears.

id.habitat: Hutan hujan tropis lebat—terutama Hutan Ituri—di bagian timur laut Republik Demokratik Kongo.
id.diet: Dedaunan pohon, kuncup, tunas, pakis, buah, dan jamur yang diraih dengan lidah biru gelapnya yang panjang.
facts: Meski kakinya belang seperti zebra, okapi adalah satu-satunya kerabat jerapah yang masih hidup dan sama-sama memiliki lidah biru panjang serta tanduk ossicone.
Lidahnya dapat menjulur hingga 45 cm—cukup panjang untuk menjilat kelopak mata dan membersihkan telinganya sendiri.
